title: Membership Charges and Payment Application — HVAC Maintenance Agreements
content:
This training note sets out how membership charges on HVAC Maintenance Agreements (Bridgewell Comfort Care) are built and billed, and how payments are applied.

## The rule

1. The membership fee covers the level's included systems; each further system adds the level's additional-system annual fee per term, billed in full on an annual agreement and in twelve equal monthly parts, rounded to the cent, on a monthly agreement.
2. A monthly agreement is charged the level's monthly fee plus the monthly part of any additional-system fees each billing period, starting on the same calendar day of the month as the term start date and due on its start.
3. An annual agreement is charged the level's annual fee plus additional-system fees once per term, on the term start date.
4. The warranty holder discount reduces the fee and additional-system fees, rounded to the cent. Whether the discount applies is decided as of the start date of the term being billed, and when it applies the charge is the fee together with the additional-system fees, multiplied by one less the warranty holder discount rate, rounded to the cent.
5. During the first price-lock terms of the level the fee stays at the amounts in force on the start date; later terms are priced at the parameters in force on the term start.
6. A visit missed without 24 hours of notice is billed the missed-appointment fee, and a returned payment is billed back with the returned-payment fee.
7. Membership fees are billed only while the agreement status is enrolled or active. The status is read from the company's agreement record.
8. Payments are applied oldest unpaid charge first.

The number of additional systems is the number of systems enrolled beyond the level's included systems; when the enrolled systems do not exceed the included systems, no additional-system fee is charged.

## Worked figures (hypothetical level and amounts)

The figures below are invented for illustration and are not the fees of any Bridgewell Comfort Care level.

*Hypothetical level:* monthly fee 20.00, annual fee 220.00, one system included, additional-system annual fee 120.00.

| Agreement | Systems enrolled | Additional systems | Additional-system amount per charge | Charge without discount | Charge with a 10% warranty holder discount |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Monthly | 1 | 0 | 0.00 | 20.00 | 18.00 |
| Monthly | 3 | 2 | 20.00 (two monthly parts of 10.00, each one twelfth of 120.00) | 40.00 | 36.00 |
| Annual | 3 | 2 | 240.00 (two full annual fees of 120.00) | 460.00 | 414.00 |

In the discounted monthly row the discount acts on the whole 40.00 (fee and additional-system parts together): 40.00 multiplied by 0.90 gives 36.00.

## Billing dates (hypothetical)

- A monthly agreement whose term starts on 17 August has billing periods starting on the 17th of each month; each monthly charge is due on its period's 17th.
- An annual agreement whose term starts on 17 August is charged once for the term, on 17 August.

## Price lock (hypothetical)

On a level with two price-lock terms, the first and second terms are charged at the amounts in force on the agreement's start date; the third term is priced at the parameters in force on the third term's start. On a level with one price-lock term, the second term is already priced at the parameters in force on its start.

## Applying a payment (hypothetical)

Charges of 25.00 due 1 January and 25.00 due 1 February are unpaid. A payment of 30.00 settles the 1 January charge in full and 5.00 of the 1 February charge, leaving 20.00 of the 1 February charge unpaid.

## Status and billing

| Agreement status | Membership fees billed |
|---|---|
| enrolled | Yes |
| active | Yes |
| expired | No |
| cancelled | No |
